title: Environmental Design and Sustainability

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Students in good academic standing may declare this major at any time.

sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

General Education Requirements

• English Composition (C) (5 credits)

• Additional Writing (W) (10 credits). Can be met by general education or major courses.

• Arts and Humanities (A&H) (20 credits)

• Social Sciences (SSc) (20 credits)

• Natural Sciences (NSc) (20 credits)

• Reasoning (RSN) (5 credits)

• Diversity (DIV) (5 credits). Can be met by general education or major courses.

L ARCH courses which are not requirements within the Environmental Design and Sustainability program may count toward A&H/SSc/NSc requirements.

Major Requirements

50 credits

• Core courses (22 credits): L ARCH 210, L ARCH 211, L ARCH 212, L ARCH 300, L ARCH 370

• Historical Context Course (5 credits): one of L ARCH 352, L ARCH 353, or L ARCH 454

• Area of Concentration Courses (11 credits): select one area of concentration 

• Environmental Design Technologies courses: L ARCH 342, L ARCH 435, L ARCH 412 (3 credits)

• Environmental Design Practice courses: L ARCH 341, L ARCH 435; and one of L ARCH 301, L ARCH 302, or L ARCH 303

• Environmental Design Equity courses: L ARCH 361, L ARCH 465, L ARCH 303

• Interdisciplinary Selective courses (12 credits): minimum 3 credits at the 300-or 400-level; see department website for list of approved courses

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA for courses applied to the major
